notes.title: Final Update + FIX
notes.content:
Added a Blur Setting to the game that can be found in the settings menu.
The timer seen in the statistics menu has been fixed to be accurate to real-time, whereas before 1 second counted in-game was less than 1 second in real time.
Fixed some bugs that crashed the game.
Improved Some Performance


This will likely be the last update for Vylan. The game, while not perfect, is in a state that I am very happy with. If there are major bugs, glitches, crashed, then a fix for that may occur in the future.

notes.title: Vylan Spring Sale Discount
notes.content:
Help Vylan on his journey to regain lost memories, in this Tile-Based platformer. Take on the 100 levels in this game that takes the platformer genre and flips it on its head.


The Game features the following:

 Tile-based Movement in a 2D platformer setting.
 100 hand crafted levels.
 4 Different worlds.
 Many unique and interesting mechanics that switch up the gameplay.
 Not too difficult.
 Solid platforming gameplay that hits the spot.

notes.title: COMPLETE VYLAN REMASTER UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello from the MOSTLY MAD PRODUCTIONS team!

It has been a wild couple of years since the release of our first game, and thinking back we decided that this game deserved specific improvements that would help the game be what it should've been from the start. This then spiraled into changing more things than we could count, which we provided a detailed list below of the majority of changes and improvements!

While almost every system and point of design has been improved, levels have remained the same, which is due to wanting to keep the levels as true to the original state of the game as possible, however for some levels minor changes have been made as to make specific sections more apparent to the eye of the player, such including making a spike put an extra block deeper.

This update also includes extra settings to customize the experience and allow more players to enjoy the game in their own way. Notable settings options that have been added include volume levels, configurable frame rate, v-sync, key binds for PC and Controller, languages (Supporting 10+ languages), and allowing the player to customize certain visual features like the new decorations, lighting, etc.

The games visuals have been improved within this update, this involves improved textures, improved camera effects, lighting, particles, and more!

We have also decided to incorporate some story elements that will link to the story to be featured within the sequel to Vylan. The story detailed is nothing too complex and leaves a lot of loose ends that will be full explained within the sequel.

The sequel for Vylan have been carefully considered and while it is far from completion, it will definitely have a different level structure from that of the first game, focusing more on story elements, opposed to a large quantity of levels that aren't necessarily linked to the game's events. Do not expect to see Vylan sequel for a long time.

We at MOSTLY MAD PRODUCTIONS hope that you enjoy this update, and we would love to hear any feedback relating to extra improvements or changes that would improve the game further.




Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Speedrun Timer FIXED!
notes.content:
Minor Update

This update, while minor is one that has been highly requested.


We have increased the amount of time that you are given on default to beat each level, allowing the player to make a few mistakes per level without ruining their chance to complete the level.
We have also fixed a few minor bugs that the time brought with it.
